applies_to: TSI PresSura Model 8631-HM hospital isolation room pressure monitors with the BACnet board.
summary: The 8631-HM monitors isolation room pressure (negative, positive or no isolation) with an optional second sensor and a flow input, and alarms on pressure and minimum flow. With the BACnet board it is a BACnet MS/TP device exposing pressures, flow, air changes per hour, alarm limits, a Status Index alarm code and the room control mode.
notes: From the Model 8631-HM BACnet MS/TP Object Set table (manual page 53). The table's Feature column is used as the object name.
The table has no read/write column. Access is inferred from the PICS, which lists Present_Value as writable for Analog, Binary and Multi-state Values only.
Units follow Units Value (MV 3): 1 = ft/min, 2 = m/s, 3 = in. H2O, 4 = Pa. Flow is cfm in English mode and l/s in metric mode.

source.title: PresSura Hospital Room Pressure Monitor/Controller, Models 8631-HM/8631-HC Operation and Service Manual

integration.summary: Set the room mode with Control Mode (MV 2) and read room pressure, flow and the Status Index (MI 1) for alarms.
setup: Set the MS/TP MAC with MAC Address (1-127) and the MAC ID with MAC ID (1-999, default 863).
The device instance is MAC ID x 1000 + MAC address; the default is 863001.
gotchas: Pressure units change with Units Value (MV 3); check it before scaling pressures in the BMS.
Changing MAC Address or MAC ID changes the device instance.

points.name: MAC ID
points.description: Range 1 to 999; sets the device instance

points.name: Status Index
points.states: 1=Normal, 2=Low Alarm, 3=High Alarm, 4=Min Flow Alarm, 5=Sec Sens Low Alarm, 6=Sec Sens High Alarm, 7=Data Error
